name: Wick Trimmer
description: A matte black wick-trimmer that perfectly trims down the wick of our fragranced candles. HOW TO USE: For each consecutive use, trim candle wick to 1/4" in order to avoid smoking. Do not burn for more than 3 hours at a time. Discontinue use when 1/4" of non-molten wax remains.

description: A hand-woven washcloth crafted from 100% natural agave fibers, offering gentle exfoliation for face and body. Its naturally textured weave softens when wet, creating a balanced cleanse that leaves skin smooth and refreshed.

description: A toothbrush crafted with a biodegradable bamboo handle, offering a simple alternative to conventional plastic designs. Its smooth, ergonomic form sits comfortably in the hand, while soft bristles cleanse teeth and gums with gentle efficacy.

description: A plant-based bathroom cleaner formulated to remove soap scum, stains, and buildup from tile, glass, sinks, and other hard surfaces. Coconut-derived cleansing agents lift residue effectively, while essential oils of lemon and rosemary lend a fresh, herbaceous note.

description: A sink set assembled to maintain a clean, orderly kitchen. The collection includes the essentials for daily dishwashing alongside a concentrated cleaning paste formulated with four elemental ingredients.

description: Trash bags made from durable, plant-based materials to provide a lower-waste alternative to conventional plastic liners. Designed to handle everyday household messes, each bag features reinforced seams and balanced thickness for strength and leak resistance.

name: Conditioner

Plant-derived ingredients work to soften and smooth strands, with our classic citrus scent that is safe for kids and sensitive skin. The result is manageable, resilient hair that feels considered and balanced.

Kaolin clay and coconut-derived cleansers work together to detoxify pores and remove buildup without stripping, while glycerin retains moisture for a soft, supple feel.

description: A dental care set composed with sustainability in mind. The bundle includes bamboo toothbrushes, biodegradable silk floss coated with candelilla wax, and a gentle toothpaste formulated for daily use. A thoughtful approach to oral care all in one place.

name: Dental Floss
description: A dental floss spun from natural silk and coated with candelilla wax to glide smoothly between teeth while remaining gentle on gums. It removes plaque and debris with quiet efficiency, supporting a clean, refreshed mouth.

name: Dish Soap
description: A concentrated, plant-based dish cleanser formulated to lift grease and residue with effective yet gentle action. Coconut-derived surfactants, sea salt, and citrus fruit acids work together to remove stubborn food without harsh chemicals or synthetic foaming agents.

name: Dishwasher Detergent Pods

name: Eye Cream
description: A lightweight eye cream formulated to refresh and support the delicate skin beneath the eyes. Caffeine, peptides, and hyaluronic acid work together to help reduce the appearance of puffiness and dark circles while providing lasting hydration.

name: Fabric Softener Sheets

name: Facial Mist
description: A facial mist composed of pure rose and jasmine essential waters to hydrate and revive the skin. The undiluted botanical blend offers light, refreshing moisture while helping to soothe and tone.

name: Facial Moisturizer
description: A lightweight facial moisturizer formulated to hydrate and support the skin’s natural barrier without heaviness. Plant-derived ingredients absorb quickly, leaving skin balanced, soft, and comfortably nourished without residue.

name: Foaming Facial Cleanser
description: A gentle foaming cleanser formulated to remove dirt, oil, and makeup while preserving the skin’s natural balance. Coconut-derived cleansers and soothing aloe work together to cleanse effectively without dryness or irritation.

name: French Press
description: A French press crafted from borosilicate glass, designed to extract coffee while preserving the beans’ natural oils and character. The 1L vessel is paired with a stainless steel lid and a fitted seal to help retain heat and ensure a secure, drip-free pour.

name: Full Body Essentials Set
description: A full body set comprising shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and lotion, formulated to cleanse, condition, and hydrate with sensitivity in mind. Gentle, sulfate-free cleansers and balanced conditioning agents support the skin’s natural moisture, leaving hair and skin soft, calm, and refreshed.

name: Garlic Press
description: A garlic press crafted from die-cast, lead-free metal with a balanced, ergonomic form. Its sturdy mechanism produces a fine, even mince with minimal effort, allowing fresh garlic to be added cleanly and efficiently to dishes. Dishwasher safe and free from plastic, it is designed for durability and simple care.

name: Glass Canister
description: Glass canisters crafted from borosilicate glass, designed to store dry goods with clarity and ease. Each vessel is fitted with an acacia wood lid and silicone seal to help maintain freshness. The transparent form reveals contents at a glance, while the natural wood lid introduces a subtle warmth to the space.

name: Glass Cleaner
description: A plant-based glass cleaner formulated to leave windows, mirrors, and glass surfaces clear and streak-free. Plant-derived ingredients from coconut, corn, and citric acid lift smudges and residue with quiet effectiveness.

name: Glass Dish Soap Dispenser
description: A dish soap dispenser crafted from borosilicate glass with a stainless steel pump. The 16oz vessel is designed to be refilled, offering a durable alternative to single-use plastic bottles. Its clear, minimal form sits easily beside the sink while keeping dish soap readily at hand.

name: Glass Drinkware Set
description: A set of four handmade borosilicate glass tumblers in two classic sizes. The smaller glasses are suited for spirits and cocktails served over ice, while the larger work well for water, iced coffee, juice, or longer drinks.

name: Glass Infusion Pitcher
description: A glass pitcher designed for brewing tea and preparing simple infusions. Handcrafted from borosilicate glass, the 1.5L vessel includes a stainless steel mesh infuser suited for loose-leaf tea, herbs, or fresh ingredients such as lemon, cucumber, or mint.

name: Hair Oil
description: A hair oil composed of plant-derived oils to nourish, smooth, and impart a soft sheen without weight or residue. The lightweight blend helps tame frizz and refine texture across a range of hair types. A subtle jasmine note lends a delicate aromatic finish. Made in the USA.

name: Hand Cream
description: A lightweight hand cream formulated to hydrate without residue. Shea butter and glycerin replenish moisture while absorbing quickly, leaving hands soft, smooth, and comfortable. A subtle citrus note offers a quiet freshness, and the compact tube is well suited for travel or daily carry. Made in the USA.

name: Hand Sanitizer Spray
description: A hand sanitizer spray formulated with 65% organic ethyl alcohol to cleanse effectively while remaining light on the skin. Botanical extracts of cinnamon leaf, juniper berry, lavender, and rosebud impart a subtle, aromatic finish. The fine mist absorbs quickly, leaving hands refreshed without residue. Made in the USA.

name: Hand Soap
description: A liquid hand soap formulated to purify without compromising the skin’s natural balance. Coconut and olive derived surfactants produce a gentle, abundant lather that rinses clean, leaving hands soft and comfortable. Made with our classic citrus scent that is safe for kids and sensitive skin. Made in Canada.

name: Hand Soap & Lotion Set
description: A simple pairing of hand soap and lotion designed to cleanse and hydrate the skin. The gentle hand soap washes effectively without dryness, while the lightweight lotion absorbs quickly to restore moisture. Light, naturally derived aromatics leave hands refreshed and comfortably soft.

name: Home Essentials Set
description: A home essentials set assembled to support the care of the kitchen, bath, laundry, and surrounding spaces. The collection brings together plant-based cleaning formulas, personal care staples, tree free paper goods, and laundry supplies designed to maintain a well-kept home.

name: Kitchen Tools Set
description: A six-piece set of kitchen tools crafted from die-cast, lead-free metal with a balanced, ergonomic form. Each piece is designed to handle common preparation tasks—from peeling and slicing to opening bottles and pressing garlic—with precision and ease.

name: Large Mugs
description: A set of four large mugs crafted from high-fired porcelain, designed to retain the temperature of hot or cold beverages. Each 15.5oz mug features a generous handle that offers a balanced, comfortable grip.

name: Laundry Detergent Pods
description: A plant-based laundry detergent formulated to lift stains and everyday soil with reliable efficacy while being gentle on fabrics and skin. Each pre-measured pod dissolves completely to deliver a powerful six-enzyme cleaning system that targets a wide range of stains.

name: Laundry Detergent Sheets
description: Laundry detergent sheets formulated to cleanse garments with a measured, low-waste approach. Powered by advanced enzyme technology and plant-based surfactants, each sheet dissolves fully in hot or cold water, targeting everyday stains while remaining gentle on fabrics.

name: Lip Balm
description: A lip balm formulated with plant-based ingredients to hydrate and protect the lips. The smooth, nourishing blend helps maintain softness and comfort, leaving lips supple and well cared for. Made in the USA.

name: Lip Treatment Balm
description: A deeply conditioning lip balm formulated to deeply hydrate, soften, and help protect against moisture loss. The rich, silky balm melts effortlessly into lips to deliver lasting comfort, conditioning, and a protective layer of hydration without stickiness.

name: Lotion
description: A lightweight, fast-absorbing lotion formulated to hydrate without residue. Coconut oil, glycerin, and plant-derived emollients work in concert to leave skin soft, smooth, and balanced. Gentle enough for sensitive skin, safe for kids and gender-neutral with a subtle lavender and eucalyptus scent. Made in Canada.

name: Micellar Cleansing Water
description: A micellar cleansing water formulated to lift away dirt, oil, and makeup—including eye and lip formulas—without the need for rinsing. The lightweight, fragrance-free solution leaves skin clean, soft, and refreshed while maintaining its natural balance.

name: Mineral SPF 30 Moisturizer
description: A lightweight, 100% mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide and titanium dioxide for broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection from UVA and UVB rays, helping prevent sunburn and early skin aging.

name: Mini Soy Candle Set
description: A set of three mini soy wax candles featuring a range of scents, from warm and woodsy to dark and fruity to soft and calming. Poured into reusable glass jars with acacia wood lids, each candle offers a clean, even burn and may be repurposed once finished for jewelry, pantry goods, or everyday storage.

name: Natural Grass Sea Sponge
description: A natural 4” sea sponge harvested from the waters of the Bahamas, offering gentle exfoliation for smooth, refreshed skin. Each piece is hand-cut to allow continued regrowth, making it a renewable alternative to synthetic bath poufs.

name: Natural Jade Gua Sha
description: A curvaceous gua sha tool handcrafted from natural jade with each piece uniquely shaped by hand. Used with gentle pressure alongside a face oil or moisturizer, it helps relieve muscle tension, boost circulation, and support lymphatic drainage for a more radiant, supple complexion.

name: Organic Aloe Vera Gel
description: A soothing gel formulated with organic aloe leaf juice to calm and hydrate skin after sun exposure or irritation. The clear, lightweight texture absorbs quickly, leaving skin refreshed and comfortable without residue.

name: Organic Bamboo Regular Pads
description: Regular pads crafted from organic bamboo pulp, designed to provide reliable protection with a light, comfortable feel. The absorbent core offers effective coverage for medium flow while remaining gentle on the skin.

name: Organic Cotton Canvas Tote Bag
description: A tote bag crafted from 100% organic cotton, designed to carry daily essentials with ease. It accommodates a laptop while remaining lightweight and durable. An integrated water bottle holder, zippered pocket, and slip pocket provide simple organization, while a magnetic clasp keeps contents secure.

name: Organic Cotton Mesh Produce Bags
description: A set of two reusable produce bags made from 100% organic cotton mesh that provide a simple, sustainable swap for single-use plastic bags. The drawstring closure keeps fruits and vegetables secure and bags are machine washable for easy care.

name: Organic Cotton Mesh Tote
description: A wide mesh tote crafted from 100% organic cotton, designed as a lightweight, reusable alternative to disposable bags. The open mesh expands to carry everything from fresh produce to wine bottles, then folds flat for compact storage when not in use. Biodegradable, vegan-friendly, and machine washable for endless reuse.

name: Organic Cotton Napkins
description: A set of four reusable napkins woven from 100% organic cotton in a textured slub finish with hand-finished edges. A simple, sustainable alternative to single-use paper, they bring a natural, refined look to everyday dining and dinner parties alike.

name: Organic Cotton Pot Holders
description: A set of two waffle knit grey pot holders made from organic cotton that is thick, heat-resistant, and free from synthetic fillers. Each holder features a stainless steel hanging ring for easy storage and is machine washable for everyday convenience.

description: A set of 2 produce bags crafted from 100% organic muslin cotton, designed as a breathable, reusable alternative to single-use plastic. The soft, sturdy fabric holds everything from bulk grains to fresh greens. Just dampen before storing leafy produce to keep it crisp longer.

name: Organic Cotton Table Runner
description: A simple, textured table runner woven from 100% organic cotton with a slub finish and hand-finished edges. It brings a natural, understated look to everyday meals and dinner parties alike, providing a clean base for serving platters or centerpieces.

description: Regular absorbency tampons crafted from 100% certified organic cotton, designed to provide reliable protection with a clean, comfortable feel. The biodegradable cardboard applicator features a smooth, rounded tip for ease of use.

description: Woven from 100% GOTS-certified organic Turkish cotton, this bathrobe is plush, breathable, and generously cut for effortless comfort. description: A duvet cover woven from 100% organic cotton, certified to GOTS and OEKO-TEX standards, with a 300 thread count sateen weave. Soft and breathable, the fabric is gentle against the skin and free from chlorine bleach and harmful additives.

description: A duvet cover and fitted sheet set woven from 100% organic cotton, certified to GOTS and OEKO-TEX standards, with a 300 thread count sateen weave. Soft and breathable, the fabric is gentle against the skin and free from chlorine bleach and harmful additives.

description: Woven from 100% GOTS-certified organic Turkish cotton at a plush 750 GSM, this hand towel is thick, soft, and highly absorbent, a simple everyday upgrade for any bathroom. Made from long-staple fibers for lasting quality and durability. Made in Turkey.

name: Organic Cotton White Pillow Case Set
description: Pillowcases woven from 100% organic cotton, certified to GOTS and OEKO-TEX standards, with a 300 thread count sateen weave. Soft and breathable, the fabric rests gently against the skin and is free from chlorine bleach and harmful additives. Includes two pillowcases.

name: Organic Shampoo Bar
description: A solid shampoo formulated to cleanse thoroughly while reducing reliance on plastic packaging. The compact bar produces a rich lather that rinses clean, leaving hair soft, balanced, and free from residue.

description: Wet wipes crafted from biodegradable bamboo fiber to cleanse hands, faces, and everyday messes with gentle efficacy. Infused with aloe and plant-based moisturizers, they leave skin refreshed and comfortable, including for babies and sensitive skin.

description: A high-protein ramen made with broad, flat noodles that are never deep-fried and free from MSG or chemical additives. The noodles cook to a satisfying texture and serve as a versatile base, equally suited for a simple bowl or enriched with vegetables, meats, or aromatics.

description: A set of reusable cleansing rounds crafted from soft bamboo fibers, offering a gentle alternative to disposable cotton. Suitable for makeup removal, toning, and everyday skincare, they cleanse effectively while remaining kind to the skin.

description: Reusable drinking straws crafted from natural bamboo, offering a durable alternative to single-use plastic. description: Reusable under-eye masks crafted from soft silicone to help treatments remain in place and absorb more effectively. Worn over serums or creams, they create a gentle seal that supports hydration and leaves the delicate eye area refreshed.

description: A double-wall insulated bottle crafted from 18/8 stainless steel, designed to maintain the temperature of both hot and cold beverages. description: A stainless steel watering can designed for easy, controlled watering. The comfortable handle and 2.5L capacity make it well suited for moving through the house and tending to multiple plants in one pass, while the long, narrow spout delivers a slow, steady pour to avoid overwatering.

description: A refillable deodorant system designed to reduce waste while maintaining daily efficacy. This aluminum and baking soda free formulation employs magnesium hydroxide and zinc to neutralize odor, offering enduring freshness without compromising skin comfort.

description: A ceramic holder designed to keep cleansing rounds neatly stored and within reach. Crafted from matte white stoneware, its simple form brings quiet order to the bathroom while complementing a minimal countertop arrangement.

description: A stoneware utensil holder crafted from matte white ceramic, designed to keep cooking tools within easy reach. Its simple, understated form accommodates spatulas, spoons, and other essentials while maintaining a clean countertop.

name: Tree Free Paper Towels
description: Paper towels crafted from renewable bamboo and sugarcane, offering a durable alternative to conventional tree-based paper products. The two-ply sheets balance strength and softness, absorbing everyday spills and tougher messes with ease.

description: Toilet paper crafted from a blend of bamboo and sugarcane pulp, offering a softer alternative to conventional toilet paper. The three-ply sheets provide strength and comfort, while each 300-sheet roll is designed to last longer than standard rolls.

name: Turkish Cotton White 500 GSM Towels
description: Woven from 100% Turkish cotton sourced from the Aegean region, these 500 GSM towels are exceptionally soft, absorbent, and built to last. Free from harmful chemical treatments, synthetic fertilizers, and pollutant dyes, they are as gentle on skin as they are on the environment.

name: Unlined Leather Notebook
description: An unlined notebook crafted with a durable hard cover made from felted wool and banana fiber. Inside, 144 pages of acid-free cotton paper, naturally free from wood pulp and chemical treatments, make it well suited for sketches, notes, or everyday thoughts.

description: Streamline your grooming with American Crew 3-in-1 Tea Tree. Designed for men who crave efficiency and revitalization, this all-in-one formula cleanses and conditions hair while refreshing the skin.

description: American Crew's aftershave balm soothes freshly shaved skin, helping to prevent irritation and minimize redness. This product serves as a daily moisturizer and provides anti-aging benefits, making it an essential part of your skincare routine.

description: Flexible Control Hair Styling Spray Provides a flexible style that gives you control of your image all day. Apply once, style anytime.

description: The American Crew Anti-Dandruff + Dry Scalp Shampoo is a highly effective dandruff shampoo and relieves irritating itch while helping prevent dandruff and dry scalp. This formula leaves hair feeling refreshed, hydrated, and manageable.

name: BEARD BALM
description: American Crew Beard Balm is a beard conditioner and styler. This beard balm tames and conditions the beard with flexible application for styling. Our versatile beard balm helps nourish and soften facial hair while providing light control to keep your beard looking well-groomed and manageable all day.

name: BEARD FOAM CLEANSER
description: Leave-in beard cleanser. Easy to use and quick absorbing dry foam with long lasting, leaving the beard clean and free of daily residue.

name: BEARD SERUM
description: Our beard serum contains a lightweight, fast-absorbing oil based formula specially designed for beard care, with beneficial oils that instantly condition and keep the beard soft and well-groomed.

name: BOOST POWDER
description: American Crew Boost Powder is an anti-gravity volume powder used to give hair lift, thickness, and a matte finish. This weightless hair texture powder adds grit for dramatic, gravity-defying texture , enhancing volume and body.

name: BOOST PRE-STYLING SHAMPOO
description: American Crew's Boost Shampoo is the ideal first step in your fine hair styling routine. After cleansing, this volumizing shampoo creates the appearance of fuller-looking hair and provides instant lift.

name: CREAM POMADE
description: American Crew's Cream Pomade is a moisture-rich natural look pomade that provides light to medium hold with a low shine finish. This versatile pomade tames hair while maintaining a soft, natural look, making it perfect for achieving a controlled yet effortless style.

name: DAILY CLEANSING SHAMPOO FOR MEN
description: Refresh and invigorate your hair every day with American Crew Daily Cleansing Shampoo . Enriched with Vitamin B5, this silicone-free, vegan formula effectively removes excess oil without drying, leaving your hair soft, manageable, and healthy-looking.

name: DAILY DEEP MOISTURIZING SHAMPOO FOR MEN
description: Quench your hair’s thirst with American Crew Daily Deep Moisturizing Shampoo, expertly crafted for men with dry to normal hair.

description: Experience the benefits of American Crew’s men's daily moisturizing conditioner, designed for triple action: restoring, strengthening, and protecting your hair. This conditioner leaves hair feeling soft, manageable, and perfectly prepped for styling.

name: DAILY SILVER SHAMPOO
description: American Crew Daily Silver Shampoo is a brightening shampoo for grey hair, designed to revitalize and brighten the hair. This shampoo for gray hair is specially formulated to enhance the natural radiance of gray and silver tones.

name: DEFINING PASTE
description: American Crew Defining Paste provides a medium hold with low shine for added texture or increased definition. The beeswax in this hair paste provides a natural, pliable hold for various lengths. The wax-like consistency of hair paste provides a matte finish while still remaining easy to distribute through hair.

name: DETOX SHAMPOO FOR MEN
description: Give your hair and scalp the ultimate reset with American Crew Detox Shampoo. Formulated with powerful ingredients like coconut shells and Manicouagan clay, this deep-cleansing shampoo removes excess oil, dirt, and product buildup without stripping essential moisture.

name: FIBER
description: American Crew's texture fiber is a high-hold, low-shine styling product that helps thicken, texturize, and add fullness to your hair. This fiber-like, resinous formula provides a strong, pliable hold with a matte finish, perfect for creating a natural, textured look.

name: FIBER CREAM
description: American Crew's Fiber Cream provides medium hold and a natural shine, making it an excellent choice for styling. This fibrous cream combines flexibility with control, giving your hair refined texture and a polished finish. Ideal for shaping and styling, it offers the perfect balance of hold and natural shine.

name: FIBER GEL
description: American Crew Fiber Gel is all about enhancing your hair’s natural texture - not hiding it.

name: FIBER GROOMING FOAM
description: Fiber Grooming Foam is a lightweight, fibrous hair foam that provides long-lasting manageable volume with medium hold and natural shine. This versatile foam for hair works well with medium to longer length hair, adding fullness and texture while keeping your style flexible and natural-looking.

name: FIBER PRE-STYLING SHAMPOO
description: American Crew's Fiber Shampoo strengthens and reconstructs the hair fiber from the inside by penetrating the cortex. This specially formulated shampoo acts as a pre-styling product for men seeking to restore shine to their limp locks without being weighed down.

description: American Crew’s strong hold hair gel, Firm Hold Styling Gel, delivers maximum holding power with a high-shine finish. Enriched with natural extracts like Vitamin B5, this gel helps your hair look thicker while providing added shine.

description: Heavy Hold Pomade is the best pomade for thick hair out of all of the American Crew hair pucks, offering a strong hold and high shine for creating sleek, smooth styles. This strong hold water-based pomade is perfect for sculpting and styling thick hair, providing lasting control and definition.

name: LIGHT HOLD STYLING GEL
description: Non-flaking formula Light Hold Styling Gel builds thickness and shine while providing light control. Our alcohol-free, flake-free formula will not dry the scalp and contains thermal barriers that protect the hair from environmental stress and blow drying or heat treatments.

name: MATTE CLAY CREAM
description: The American Crew Matte Clay Cream is a go-to hair clay styling option for men who want lightweight control, and a clean, matte finish. Powered by kaolin clay and made with 92% naturally derived ingredients, it delivers medium hold while helping to detox the scalp.

name: Matte Clay Spray
description: The American Crew Matte Clay Spray, formulated with Kaolin Clay, provides major texture and body to the hair, and has strong medium hold that lasts all day.

name: MEDIUM HOLD SPRAY GEL

description: American Crew's moisturizing shaving cream is suitable for all skin types, offering a smooth, close shave while preventing dryness. This non-drying formula helps alleviate irritation, providing a comfortable shave every time.

name: POMADE
description: Our pomade provides a medium hold with high shine. This product works well for curly hair and provides a modern, flexible alternative to styling gels.
